source_review.title: Vitamin D supplementation and all-cause mortality: a systematic review and meta-analysis

conclusion_summary: Vitamin D supplementation does not reduce all-cause mortality in the general older adult population; routine supplementation not supported by evidence.
limitations: Many trials included vitamin D-sufficient participants
Variable dosing regimens and baseline status
Most trials not designed for mortality as primary endpoint

quantitative_claims.claim: No significant reduction in mortality (RR 0.98, 95% CI 0.95-1.02)
6-8% improvement in muscle strength with vitamin D in deficient individuals
